resources.string: After signing in, your authorized ChatGPT plan can only be used within Lyra Code. OpenAI may change, restrict, or stop this feature at any time. Follow ChatGPT terms and policies. Do not resell or share credentials, abuse the service, or engage in prohibited activity; this may result in an official warning, restrictions, or suspension of your ChatGPT account.

Sign-in takes place in a browser tab and can reuse sign-in state from your selected browser. This app does not receive your ChatGPT password or existing chats. Credentials are encrypted on this device and excluded from exported backups.

Uses your authorized ChatGPT plan without an API key. Requests use Responses and the current account’s model catalog through its selected login mode. Custom endpoints, request overrides, and media generation are unavailable.

This optional mode uses the Codex OAuth flow and private OpenAI endpoints. It is separate from official SIWC and requires a new browser sign-in. OpenAI may change or restrict it at any time. Only use it within Lyra Code and comply with ChatGPT policies. The browser callback needs local port 1455; close other sign-in windows if that port is occupied.

Codex allowance is queried from OpenAI when this page opens, before requests, and about once a minute while the app is visible. Only limits actually returned by OpenAI are shown. Missing, stale, or reset data is unavailable; failed refreshes retain the last observation. Codex limits can differ from official SIWC and ChatGPT app limits.
Complete ChatGPT sign-in and authorization in your browser, then return to Lyra Code. Waiting for up to 5 minutes.
Signed in with ChatGPT. This account’s model service is synchronized and active.
Signed in with ChatGPT, but model synchronization did not finish. Retry synchronization on this page.
ChatGPT plan usage is not authorized. Continue with ChatGPT again to grant permission, or select another model service.
The ChatGPT request did not finish. Check your connection and retry.
Cannot open device-encrypted ChatGPT storage. Check device security settings. Credentials will not be stored as plaintext.
OpenAI has not provided the current plan. View your Free, Go, Plus, Pro, or other plan in ChatGPT.

The official integration currently provides no plan or allowance query API. Only recent data actually returned by OpenAI is shown here; missing, stale, or reset data is unavailable. ChatGPT usage settings show the applicable plan and app limits. Plus users share the 5-hour allowance across apps.
Sync models and use this account
Synchronized the available models and switched to this account’s service.
Refreshed models and account data returned by OpenAI.
Local credentials were cleared, but remote session revocation could not be confirmed. Disconnect this app in ChatGPT settings.
Continue with ChatGPT above to add another account or workspace. Saved accounts reuse their registration when signing in again.

This request reached a ChatGPT plan or app usage limit. Your conversation, generated content, and completed tool operation records have been preserved. Manage usage in ChatGPT first. When allowance becomes available, or after switching model services, select Continue in this conversation.

ChatGPT sign-in is optional and uses the ChatGPT service provided by OpenAI. Official SIWC sign-in and Codex compatibility sign-in use separate authorization flows. Codex compatibility relies on private interfaces. OpenAI may change, restrict, or stop these features and their available models or allowances at any time. A ChatGPT subscription does not supply an API key for this integration.

Use your authorized subscription only within Lyra Code and follow ChatGPT terms and policies. Do not resell or share credentials, abuse the service, bypass authorization, or engage in prohibited activity. Violations may result in an official warning, restrictions, or suspension of your ChatGPT account.

The composer displays the reported five-hour allowance, or weekly allowance when the five-hour window does not apply. Lower allowance does not trigger a warning dialog. Missing, stale, or reset data is marked unavailable; displayed percentages do not guarantee that a request will be admitted. If allowance is exhausted or the service rejects further usage, the task pauses and retains conversation history, generated content, and completed tool operation records. You can continue after allowance becomes available or after selecting another service. Completed external actions are not undone by a pause.

When you choose ChatGPT sign-in, authorization takes place in the system browser with OpenAI. Lyra Code does not receive your ChatGPT password or existing ChatGPT chats. The app processes the returned account or workspace identifier, email, plan, available models, usage windows, reset times, and OAuth credentials to sign in, refresh access, synchronize models, and display allowance. OAuth credentials are encrypted in device-local storage and excluded from app backups, model profiles, request previews, and HTTP audit exports.\n\nAuthorization, token refresh, model and usage queries, and model requests connect directly to OpenAI. Depending on the operation, OpenAI receives authorization information, the selected conversation context, tool results, attachments included in the request, and connection information such as the IP address. Processing by OpenAI follows its policies. Signing out stops tasks using that account, clears local credentials, and attempts remote session revocation. Local conversation records and provider configuration remain; using that account again requires authorization.
